definitions.explanation: A break or crack in a bone.

examples.japanese: {足|あし}を{骨折|こっせつ}した。
{骨折|こっせつ}は{全治|ぜんち}2か{月|げつ}だそうだ。
examples.english: They say the fracture will take two months to heal completely.

examples.japanese: {骨折|こっせつ}した{場所|ばしょ}がまだ{痛|いた}い。
examples.english: The place where I fractured the bone still hurts.

examples.japanese: スキーで{転倒|てんとう}して{骨折|こっせつ}し、{救急|きゅうきゅう}{車|しゃ}で{病院|びょういん}に{運|はこ}ばれた。{全治|ぜんち}3か{月|げつ}と{診断|しんだん}された。
examples.english: I fell while skiing and broke a bone, and was taken to the hospital by ambulance. I was diagnosed with a full recovery time of three months.

notes:
{骨折|こっせつ} means a bone fracture.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {骨折|こっせつ}する (to fracture a bone)
- 〜を{骨折|こっせつ}する (to fracture one's ~)
- {骨折|こっせつ}が{治|なお}る (the fracture heals)

TYPES OF FRACTURES:
- {複雑|ふくざつ}{骨折|こっせつ} (compound fracture)
- {単純|たんじゅん}{骨折|こっせつ} (simple fracture)
- {疲労|ひろう}{骨折|こっせつ} (stress fracture)

MEDICAL TERMS:
- {全治|ぜんち}〜{週間|しゅうかん}/{か月|げつ} (full recovery in ~ weeks/months)
- ギプス (cast)
- レントゲン (X-ray)
